verdict.rationale: Persona docs confirm webhooks notify services about events on resources and that event subsets can be filtered, supporting an event-driven (non-polling) integration pattern. However, the evidence pack lacks any mention of webhook signing/signature verification or the specific lifecycle event names (created, processing, verified, requires-input) cited in the story. Missing for 10: signed-webhook/HMAC verification documentation, enumerated inquiry/verification lifecycle event types, and independent confirmation of reliability.
